input.command: cd D:\pal; echo "== what owns 5432 =="; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 5432 | ForEach-Object { $pr = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "pid=$($_.OwningProcess) name=$($pr.ProcessName) path=$($pr.Path) start=$($pr.StartTime) addr=$($_.LocalAddress)" }; echo "== health =="; try { (Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8082/health' -TimeoutSec 10) | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } catch { "ERR $($_.Exception.Message)" }
